verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's own docs show it automates creating incident Slack channels, Jira tickets, and Zoom meeting bridges, and joins Zoom bridges to transcribe them. Slack works in both directions: `/fh` commands and `/fh update` notes in Slack flow back into the incident and its internal status page. Microsoft Teams and GitHub are never mentioned, and Jira and Zoom are only shown being pushed to, not syncing state back. missing for 10: Microsoft Teams integration, GitHub integration, evidence of bidirectional Jira sync (ticket status flowing back), independent or hands-on corroboration.
